description: Deploy missing IAM policies to ECS task role that are blocking Silver operations
steps: Verify ECSConcurrencyGuard policy is missing from prediction-data-task-prod role
Verify GlueCatalogAccess policy is missing from prediction-data-task-prod role
Verify S3SilverBucketAccess policy is missing from prediction-data-task-prod role
Update prediction-data-iam-roles CloudFormation stack with correct parameters

Run: aws cloudformation update-stack --stack-name prediction-data-iam-roles --template-body file://infrastructure/iam-ecs-roles.yaml --parameters ParameterKey=Environment,ParameterValue=prod ParameterKey=BronzeBucketArn,ParameterValue=arn:aws:s3:::prediction-bronze-prod ParameterKey=SilverBucketArn,ParameterValue=arn:aws:s3:::prediction-silver-prod --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
Verify all three policies now exist on the role via aws iam list-role-policies

description: Fix Docker image missing pyarrow dependency that blocks all Silver operations
steps: Identify that Silver catchup tasks fail with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pyarrow'
Update Dockerfile to install prediction-data[backfill] which includes pyarrow
Rebuild and push Docker image to ECR
Verify Silver catchup task starts without pyarrow import error

description: Verify ECS concurrency guard works after IAM fix
steps: Trigger a Silver catchup task and check CloudWatch logs
Confirm no more AccessDeniedException for ecs:ListTasks
Verify concurrency guard correctly detects running tasks
Verify --skip-if-concurrent flag works as expected

description: Verify Silver processing pipeline is functioning correctly
steps: Run prediction-data silver catchup --platform polymarket --entity trades --dry-run
Verify Silver trades table has recent data via Athena or PyIceberg query
Check Silver markets and events tables are being updated
Verify no errors in recent Silver processing CloudWatch logs

description: Verify Silver maintenance jobs are working
steps: Check silver-maintain-compact-prod schedule is running successfully
Check silver-maintain-full-prod schedule is running successfully
Verify compaction is reducing file counts in Iceberg tables
Verify snapshot expiration is working (check metadata file counts)

description: Ensure CloudWatch monitoring catches Silver failures
steps: Verify Silver-related CloudWatch metric filters exist in cloudwatch-monitoring.yaml
Verify Silver error alarms are configured and working
Test that IAM permission errors would trigger alerts
Document any gaps in Silver monitoring coverage

description: End-to-end validation of Silver layer health
steps: Query Silver polymarket.trades table and verify data freshness (should be within 1 day)
Query Silver polymarket.markets table and verify recent updates
Query Silver polymarket.events table and verify recent updates
Run prediction-data silver catchup for all entities and verify success
Document current Silver data coverage and any gaps
